Maya (PM): Quick thread  idea: run a 6-week "compliance-first" DP cohort for PHI/regulated workloads. Need recruitment screener + hard gates for private-only asks. Input?
Dev (Compliance Eng): Love it. Hard gate: if partner requires on-prem or HSM-only, must be flagged as "private deployment" and routed to Private track. No exceptions.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Screener draft (1-min): 1) Use case summary; 2) Data types (PHI/PII/PI); 3) Deployment preference (hosted/dedicated/private); 4) Expected QPS + p95; 5) Integration ETA (hours).
Nina (Design): Add a checkbox for "requires audit logs" and another for "needs SOC2/HIPAA paperwork" so legal triage is fast. Keep copy terse.
Sam (SRE): Ops note: for Private track we require pre-onboard runbook + customer KMS fingerprint. Also need an agreed retention window. I'll draft minimal runbook items.
Jordan (Legal): Flag: consent + data sharing must be explicit. For PHI we'll default to no log retention unless customer opts in. I'll prepare a short consent clause and a DPIA checklist.
Maya (PM): Proposed prioritization rubric: compliance-risk (1-5 inverse), impact (1-5), integration effort (1-5). Accept if (impact - risk) >= 2 and effort <=3. Thoughts?
Dev (Compliance Eng): Works. Also add a veto for any partner that cannot demonstrate a contractual frame for data handling (even for beta).
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Launch gates: 1) Recruit: >=6 qualified across private/dedicated; 2) Onboard: 2 private track partners validated; 3) Safety: zero P0 incidents and audit log capture validated; 4) Legal: DPIA and minimal contract signed. Pause cohort if any fail.
Nina (Design): I'll prepare a short invite banner: "Compliance-first DP — private options, auditability, and joint playbook" with CTA to the screener.
Jordan (Legal): I'll draft the consent + minimum contract addendum and post here for review tomorrow.
Maya (PM): Action items: Ravi = final screener + triage rubric; Nina = banner + microcopy; Sam = runbook stub; Jordan = consent + addendum; Dev = compliance checklist. I'll assemble the one-pager by Wed EOD and we send outreach next Mon.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll also include a sample `curl` for private onboarding and KMS confirm steps.
Sam (SRE): I'll ensure runbook includes escalation contact and retention toggles (30/90).
Maya (PM): Thanks team. If no objections, we launch recruitment next week. :lock: :rocket:
